I am as a Senior Staff Engineer at "Sfeir," a consulting firm specializing in digital and technological strategy, and a Google Cloud partner.

At Sfeir, I work with French and European companies on topics related to Google Cloud and also on projects involving APIs.

As a cloud architect, I guide Sfeir's clients in their roadmap for transitioning to the Cloud. I also lead the client's roadmap to setup Apigee (Google API Management product) and cover all aspects of adopting an "API First" approach.

In my role as a Google Trainer, I primarily deliver courses on Google infrastructure and development. I am also the lead trainer for Apigee and Apigee Hybrid at Sfeir.

I am a speaker on topics related to cloud and APIs.

Google Cloud Certifications:
